page: Microsoft Azure E96d_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V. It is powered by a dedicated 2.8 GHz Intel Xeon 8370C processor built on x86_64 architecture, providing 48 physical cores and 96 vCPUs via two threads per core. The instance is configured with 672.0 GB of system memory, yielding 7.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware features include 48 MB of L3 cache, instruction set extensions such as AVX-512 with VNNI, and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA-NI. The instance contains zero GPUs.

The configuration includes 3,865 GB of integrated local SSD storage. In synthetic evaluations, the platform demonstrates strong multi-threaded execution across its 96 vCPUs, evidenced by top-quartile results in stress-ng multi-core testing, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and Geekbench multi-core workloads. Memory throughput is substantial, measuring 327.92 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 134.17 GB/sec for writes. PassMark database tests recorded 30,002.78 operations, complemented by Redis SET throughput reaching 88.48 million operations per second. Hardware encryption tests register in the top ten percent due to dedicated vector AES extensions.

Single-threaded metrics, including single-core stress-ng and Geekbench evaluations, remain in the middle fifty percent, reflecting the baseline 2.8 GHz clock speed rather than single-thread frequency optimization. Without discrete GPUs, large language model text generation throughput diminishes sharply, reaching weak performance levels on 70B parameter models. The bundled local storage and high memory footprint deliver operational efficiency for stateful, memory-heavy workloads without requiring external network storage for temporary files. The instance fits in-memory databases, large-scale Redis caching layers, relational database hosting, and high-throughput static web serving.
description: Microsoft Azure E96d_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 96 vCPUs and 48 physical cores powered by a dedicated 2.8 GHz Intel Xeon 8370C processor on the x86_64 architecture. The system provides 672.0 GB of RAM alongside 3,865 GB of attached local SSD storage. It incorporates AVX-512 and cryptographic accelerators, yielding top-tier encryption performance and top-quartile multi-core benchmark results in stress-ng and Geekbench. While single-thread benchmarks place in the median range and absence of a GPU restricts large-scale machine learning inference, memory subsystem benchmarks demonstrate strong throughput with 327.92 GB/sec read bandwidth. The included high-capacity local SSD offers efficient local caching and high IOPS without separate block storage overhead. The instance is suited for in-memory databases, Redis caching clusters, high-concurrency relational database workloads, and high-volume static data processing.
